name: Defend Shugo Merchants (Shugo Festival) reward cards, 2026-10-29 13:04:58 to 13:05:02, the screen's last five seconds ("00:05", "Can select 0 time(s)"): cards 2, 3 and 4 picked once each (their cyan "1"), cards 1 and 5 not.
